content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ECHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.echs.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 05-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for ECHS Recruitment 2026 is 05 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ECHS?
faq.answer: ECHS has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Medical Officer and Gynaecologist in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for ECHS Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Medical Officer post is Rs. 95,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Gynaecologist post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Gynaecologist post is Rs. 1,30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the Medical Officer post, candidates need to have an MBBS degree with a minimum of three years of work experience after internship. Additional qualifications in Medicine/Surgery are preferred.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for the Gynaecologist post?
faq.answer: For the Gynaecologist post, candidates must possess an MD/MS in the concerned specialty or DNB, with a minimum of three years of experience in the specialty after post-graduation.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for ECHS Recruitment 2026 for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for ECHS Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of ECHS, which is www.echs.gov.in.
